attributes.action: Restrict  sale of fireworks to individuals or groups for organised display only.
attributes.additional_details: Misuse of fireworks in anti social behaviour, endangering life and property, threatening the emergency services and taking the police, fire and health services away from their normal roles has been excessive and unacceptable this November in particular. Stricter governance on the sale of fireworks  throughout the year is needed to preserve the emergency services for the purpose they are intended and not deployed for dangerous behaviour through the irresponsible use of fireworks by individuals.
attributes.background: Sale of fireworks all through the year to be limited to anyone organising a public display of fireworks who would need a licence subject to Risk Assessment and responsibility for misuse or damage.  Fireworks only to be sold to Licence holder and all other sales of fireworks to become illegal.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
